description: Search open AI training jobs (rating, writing and reviewing AI output, paid by AI labs) across vetted platforms. Filter by field, country, minimum hourly pay, platform, language and kind of data work. Returns each job with stated pay, who can apply and a url to its page (where the person applies).

beginner_only.description: Only roles that need no degree or specialist experience.

country.description: Where the person lives: a country name, slug or ISO code (e.g. "India", "united-states", "PH"). "any" turns the filter off.

field.description: Field of expertise: software (Engineers, data scientists, ML people); medicine (Physicians, nurses, dentists, clinicians); science (Physicists, chemists, biologists, engineers); math (Mathematicians, statisticians, theorem provers); finance (Analysts, accountants, bankers, consultants); law (Attorneys, paralegals, compliance experts); language (Native speakers, translators, linguists); audio (Voice actors, transcribers, recorders); writing (Writers, editors, copywriters); design (Designers, illustrators, artists, musicians); humanities (Teachers, professors, historians, social scientists); general (Evaluators and raters, often no degree needed).

language.description: A language the role asks for, e.g. "Spanish".

min_hourly_usd.description: Minimum top hourly rate in USD, e.g. 50.

only_named_country.description: With country: only listings that name the country or say worldwide. Default false also keeps listings that only say "Remote" (location not stated), listed after the ones that name it.

query.description: Words in the job title or platform name, e.g. "nurse", "Python", "Hindi".

sort.description: new (default) or pay (highest top rate first).

task.description: Kind of data work the title names: rating (rate, rank and review AI answers); annotation (label images, video, audio and documents); collection (record voice, video or photos for training data); transcription (transcribe speech); "data" = any of them. Most expert roles name no task.

name: search_jobs
title: Search AI training jobs
